## Change

Describe the user-facing or research objective and the specific changes.

## Validation

Describe the tests actually run and their results. Identify tests or external checks still outstanding.

## Evidence and operational impact

- [ ] Original evidence archives and historical authorization records are unchanged, or an explicitly reviewed new record is provided.
- [ ] Claims, scores, denominators and costs are scoped to observed evidence.
- [ ] No credentials or unauthorized private data are included.
- [ ] No unintended paid inference, duplicate authorization or automatic retry is introduced.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.

## Limitations

Identify unresolved issues, assumptions and decisions needing review.
